quotes.speaker: Naz Reid
quotes.summary_phrase: Naz Reid on his expanded role with the Charlotte Hornets
quotes.excerpt: I'm getting a lot more involved into the offenses and also defense.
quotes.quote: I'm getting a lot more involved into the offenses and also defense. Just making sure I'm playing at my highest point possible and having a lot of intensity and effort while I'm doing so.
quotes.social_post: Naz Reid says he is getting much more involved in the Hornets offense and defense this season, focusing on playing with high intensity and effort.

quotes.speaker: Naz Reid
quotes.summary_phrase: Naz Reid on his transition to the Charlotte Hornets
quotes.excerpt: It's been tough for me just because I'm trying to get stuff together off the court and on the court.
quotes.quote: It's been tough for me just because I'm trying to get stuff together off the court and on the court. It hasn't been super sweet, but I think everybody here has been able to welcome me and being patient with me. That's been huge for me to get to this point where I am now. I've gotten to weather a storm, getting here, and they were patient with me and I was able to become the person that I am to this day.
quotes.social_post: Naz Reid opens up about his transition to Charlotte, noting that while it has been tough getting things together on and off the court, the team has been patient with him throughout the process.

quotes.speaker: Naz Reid
quotes.summary_phrase: Naz Reid on Brandon Miller's leadership and growth
quotes.excerpt: His patience, his consistency, and I think his leadership is starting to kind of form.
quotes.quote: His patience, his consistency, and I think his leadership is starting to kind of form. That's big in a younger guy. I was with Ant, who I started to see his shifts and his change going from his third year to his fourth year, and I think Brandon can do the same. I'm coming here to help out this team, him and Khan, and I'm here to help in a big way. The growth for him would be to lead on and off the court and just be consistent and do the things that you preach.
quotes.social_post: Naz Reid sees major growth in Brandon Miller, comparing his leadership development to what he witnessed with Anthony Edwards. Reid says he is here to help Miller lead on and off the court.
